Returns the instantiated nominal WF obligations for a definition after remapping them to non-const predicates. This method calls `nominal_obligations_inner`.

Computes the region bounds required by a trait object's existential predicates by substituting a fresh placeholder self type, ignoring projection predicates, and delegating the final extraction to `required_region_bounds`. It calls `required_region_bounds`.

Checks a foreign item after precollecting its type information, validating foreign functions and statics while accepting foreign types unchanged. It calls `check_item_fn` and `check_item_type`.

Builds a fresh inference context, computes implied outlives bounds for the provided well-formed types, lets the caller add extra region constraints, resolves regions, and returns whether no region errors occurred. Visits a type to collect generic arguments from projections of the target GAT. Returns whether a HIR type syntactically looks like a single-segment trait object naming the enclosing trait, indicating it may have meant `Self`; it does not call other methods from the Methods List.

Checks an impl item after precollecting its types, choosing an appropriate diagnostic span for methods and associated types before delegating to associated-item WF checking. It calls `check_associated_item`.

Checks generic-parameter well-formedness, focusing on const parameters: it either enforces the relevant lang-item trait bound in a WF context on feature-enabled paths or emits structural-match style diagnostics on stable paths. Maps an `ItemKind` to its corresponding `AdtKind`, returning `Some(Struct)`, `Some(Union)`, or `Some(Enum)` for ADT items and `None` for all other item kinds. It does not call any other methods from the provided Methods List.

Checks structs, unions, and enums for representability and field/type well-formedness, enforces `Sized` where required for non-tail fields or packed/drop-sensitive layouts, registers extra obligations such as const evaluatability, and validates where-clauses. Validates explicit bounds on a trait associated type by normalizing each bound, expanding it into clause well-formedness obligations, and registering those obligations. It calls `WfCheckingCtxt::tcx` and `WfCheckingCtxt::normalize`.
Checks a free or foreign function signature inside a dedicated WF context using the instantiated function signature. It calls `enter_wf_checking_ctxt`.

Checks the declared type of an item in a WF context by normalizing it, registering its well-formedness, optionally enforcing `Sized` depending on unsized-handling rules, and requiring `Sync` for eligible shared statics. Visits a type and tracks referenced type parameters. It checks `t.kind()` for `ty::Param`, inserts the parameter index into the set when found, and then calls `super_visit_with` to keep traversing nested type structure.

Visits a const argument and tracks referenced const parameters. It checks `c.kind()` for `ty::ConstKind::Param`, inserts the parameter index into the set when present, and then calls `super_visit_with` to continue traversing nested const structure.

Well-formedness-checks a function or method signature by liberating late-bound regions, normalizing each input/output type with per-parameter locations, registering WF obligations for every input/output type, and checking where-clauses. Initializes trait-method RPITIT bound checking for a function return type. Validates a method's `self` receiver by normalizing the method signature, `self_ty`, and receiver type, then checking receiver legality. Emits error E0307 for an invalid `self` parameter type, adding an explanatory note and help text before returning the emitted diagnostic. It directly calls `dcx`, `with_note`, `with_help`, and `emit`.

Determines whether a method receiver type is valid for a given `Self` type by first trying direct type equality, then autodereferencing toward `self_ty`, registering autoderef obligations on success. Checks whether a candidate receiver type satisfies the `Receiver` lang-item trait by building the trait obligation and testing it with `predicate_must_hold_modulo_regions`; it does not call other methods from the list.

Checks that generic parameters of an ADT or lazy type alias are sufficiently constrained for variance computation, skipping items whose field/alias types already contain errors.
